disqualifier.note: Named options on runResearchInstallTimers. uninstall true skips installTimers entirely, so refresh absent/false/true all remain accepted uninstall requests. uninstall false with refresh absent, false, or true are install requests. All six declared combinations are legal inputs; uninstall dominating refresh is priority, not an excluded state.

directory is the stat type bit; millis is Option of File.Info.mtime, which the filesystem contract allows to be absent on a successful stat. UNREADABLE_ENTRY writes none/false, and the success arm writes directory from type independently of O.map(mtime). A directory or file with no mtime is a supported reading, so none/true is legal alongside some/true, some/false, and none/false. Readers use the axes separately (entryMillis drops none; treeMillis filters directory).

Raw CLI request object passed to runWorktreeRemove, distinct from the resolved WorktreeRemovalRequest. --delete-branch without --archive is a specified diagnostic of that request, so all four input pairs are in the request domain. The resolved operation owner still rejects deleteBranch without archive; this record does not narrow that stored contract.

probeFailed does not duplicate mergeBase presence. unmeasuredSignals writes false/null (head-unknown and target-unmaterialized); a resolved merge-base with a later diff failure writes true/string; MERGE_BASE_PROBE_FAILED writes true/null; a clean derivation writes false/string. All four boolean-times-presence pairs are produced.
